get_dataset.description: Get one NESO dataset with every file in it: what it holds, its topic, tags, licence and update frequency, and each file's id, format, download address, last change and whether it is a data table that 'Read rows' can read. A dataset NESO doesn't have comes back with 'found' set to false. No API key required.

dataset.description:
The carbon intensity of electricity measures how much carbon dioxide emissions are produced per kilowatt hour.
This dataset contains data from 1 January 2009. It has seasonal decomposition applied to correct missing or irregular data points. The data is subject to change due to a data cleansing process taking place to provide the most accurate figures.
Batteries (NET discharge) are currently included in the OTHER category. Transmission-connected solar farms are currently included in the OTHER category. Pumped Storage units (NET) are represented in the STORAGE category. All Net-Negative values are curtailed at zero.
Updates will be released later in 2026, to highlight BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) and Transmission Solar values.

columns.description: This is the Great Britain generation requirement and is equivalent to the Initial National Demand Outturn (INDO) and National Demand Forecast as published on BM Reports. National Demand is the sum of metered generation, but excludes generation required to meet station load, pump storage pumping and interconnector exports. columns.description: This is the Transmission System generation requirement and is equivalent to the Initial Transmission System Outturn (ITSDO) and Transmission System Demand Forecast on BM Reports. Transmission System Demand is equal to the ND plus the additional generation required to meet station load, pump storage pumping and interconnector exports. Transmission System Demand is calculated using Nationnal Grid ESO operational metering. Note that the Transmission System Demand includes an estimate of station load of 500MW in BST and 600MW in GMT.

run_sql_query.description: Run your own read-only SQL SELECT on NESO's data tables, for date ranges, sums, averages and joins: tables by their id and columns by their id, in double quotes. Up to 1,000 rows come back, and a row with a settlement date and period also gets the half hour's start and end in UTC. NESO asks for at most two of these data reads a minute. No API key required.

description: The open data of Great Britain's National Energy System Operator (NESO, formerly National Grid ESO): every dataset on its Data Portal, from electricity demand and generation history to forecasts, interconnector flows and balancing costs. Search the catalogue, read any data table with filters or SQL, or get the figures ready to use: national demand, the generation mix, interconnector flows, the demand, wind and embedded solar forecasts, and balancing costs. For the carbon intensity of electricity, use Carbon Intensity. No account or API key required.
